WoW: Forever

Affliction Warlock

Stacked shadow damage-over-time spells plus channelled drains, "for players who enjoy watching their enemies slowly rot away."

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 31, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. Talent tiers unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 before Legacy TalentedTalentedTalentCastInstantYou gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.. No source had posted a level 30 build when this page was written, so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs — not a build any guide has recommended. These pages follow the hotfix Blizzard pushed to the launch realms on October 30, read from the game's hotfix data. Blizzard has not announced it, so it may still move before November 4. Hover tooltips read the base client and can lag a hotfix: where one differs from the text here, the text is right.

What Affliction is for

Timed damage that keeps paying out while you do something else. Improved CorruptionImproved CorruptionTalentCastInstantReduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%. 5/5 makes CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 7Cast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secCorrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec. instant from level 14, and in Forever those ticks can critically strike. PandemicPandemicTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%. from 22 doubles the critical damage of CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 7Cast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secCorrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec., both Banes, Siphon LifeSiphon LifeLevel 30 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost150 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration30 secTransfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec. and both Drains. Your damage keeps landing while you move, wand or Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted..

"Affliction Warlocks have always been excellent levelers, and that strength shows up early in WoW Forever… Learning how to balance those tools lets you move through enemies with very little downtime." Icy Veins rates its levelling 5 out of 5, joint best in the class.

Its weakness is short fights, and two sources say so: "Affliction performs best when enemies live long enough for your DoTs to ramp up. Fast dungeon pulls can end before that setup has time to pay off." Another source puts it bluntly: "On a target that dies in ten seconds, you paid full mana and cast time for half a spell's worth of damage."

Icy Veins' dungeon score for it is 4.0, against 5.0 for levelling.

Learn to stop casting when your existing damage-over-time effects will finish the job.

Rotation

Icy Veins and Wowhead order the opening DoTs differently, and both give a reason.

Icy Veins' order (Immolate, then Corruption, then Bane of Agony) leads with the DoT that pays off fastest.

Wowhead reverses it, Bane of Agony first, Corruption, Immolate last, arguing threat: "Bane of Agony first: it deals the least upfront damage, so it's the least threat and requires time to build up to full damage. Immolate last; its initial Hit generates direct threat, so it's the worst opener."

  1. Send the demon in first
  2. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Stat priority

Spell Power, then Hit, Intellect, Spirit, critical strike, Stamina, Haste.

Two of those placements are Forever-specific. Spirit is high because "Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted. has changed and now scales off of your Spirit." Critical strike matters "much more than it was in original Classic" because damage-over-time effects can now crit. Haste is last: it "did not make DoTs or Drain channels tick faster."

Your demon

All four come from class quests: Imp at 2, VoidwalkerVoidwalkerLevel 10 · Spell · ShadowCast10 sec castCost100% of base ManaDurationUntil cancelledSummons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock. at 10, Succubus at 20, Felhunter at 30.

VoidwalkerVoidwalkerLevel 10 · Spell · ShadowCast10 sec castCost100% of base ManaDurationUntil cancelledSummons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock. is the levelling pet: "your tanky option and the best option to use once you unlock it." It "can literally face tank multiple enemies, while you DoT them all up." Its threat comes from TormentTormentTalent · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost20 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownTaunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Voidwalker., which Wowhead notes is noticeably weaker until rank 2 trains at 20. Succubus "deals insanely high damage compared to the other available demons."

What Forever changed for Affliction

  • Damage-over-time effects can critically strike. One source calls it "one of the largest overall Warlock mechanical changes". Both MalevolenceMalevolenceTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 5%. and PandemicPandemicTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%. are new talents built on it.
